title: How a Godly Man Stays Humble When He's the One Who's Right
caption:
You were right. Everybody in the room knows it. That's not the hard part.

The hard part is what you do in the next ten seconds. The urge to rub it in, to make sure he says it out loud, to bring it up again next week. That's not insecurity. It's leverage. And it's the opposite of what a godly man does with the truth.

Being right isn't the win. Staying humble while you're right is. Say it once and let it stand. Let him walk it back without an audience. Don't need the room to clap for you.

"Humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, so that at the proper time he may exalt you." (1 Peter 5:6)

God already knows who was right. That's enough.

Save this for the next time you're right and it's tempting to make sure everyone knows it.
